# Environment variable matrix

<!-- GENERATED by `npm run env:matrix` (scripts/env-matrix.ts) from .env.example and a scan of process.env reads. Do not edit. -->

Columns: **used by** comes from the code scan (lib/, app/, worker/, mcp/, scripts/, instrumentation.ts, proxy.ts); **required in** is
`dev` when `.env.example` sets the variable uncommented, `prod` for the production essentials, `e2e`/`CI` for test tooling, otherwise `optional`.
**Default** is the value `.env.example` shows (an example, not always a code default). **Secret** marks values that must never be logged
or committed. Notes are the comment above the variable in `.env.example`.

## Auth, API keys and secrets

| Variable | Used by | Required in | Default | Secret | Milestone | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MEETSUM_SESSION_SECRET` | app | dev, prod | `(example only)` | yes |  | Placeholder ("replace-with-...", "dev-secret") secrets are rejected at boot when NODE_ENV=production. |
| `MEETSUM_ALLOWED_EMAILS` | app | dev | `you@example.com` | no |  | Bootstrap allowlist (M2): these emails always get a membership in the default workspace (the Workspace subject, else the first email, is its owner; the rest are admins). Everyone else joins by invitation only. |
| `MEETSUM_ALLOW_WORKSPACE_CREATION` | app | dev | `false` | no |  | Allow signed-in users to create additional workspaces (default false; only the literal value `true` enables it). |
| `MEETSUM_INVITE_TTL_HOURS` | app | dev | `168` | no |  | Invitation link lifetime in hours (default 168 = 7 days). |
| `MEETSUM_API_KEYS` | app | dev | `(example only)` | yes |  | Every API request needs credentials (session cookie or bearer key). Env bootstrap keys below are bound to one workspace with limited scopes; create further keys (read / write / admin scopes) in Settings → API keys. |

| `MEETSUM_API_KEY_HASHES` | app | dev |  | no |  |  |
| `MEETSUM_ENV_API_KEY_WORKSPACE_ID` | app | dev | `ws_default` | no |  |  |
| `MEETSUM_ENV_API_KEY_SCOPES` | app | dev | `read,write` | no |  | Comma-separated subset of read,write,admin (default read,write). |

## Hebrew ASR + diarization (M3)

| Variable | Used by | Required in | Default | Secret | Milestone | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MEETSUM_ASR_CHAIN` | app | optional | `runpod-ivrit,modal-worker,soniox,local-whisper-chunked` | no | M3 | Provider order for Hebrew / mixed meetings, and for other languages. Providers without credentials are skipped. |
| `MEETSUM_ASR_CHAIN_NON_HE` | compose/infra | optional | `soniox,runpod-ivrit,modal-worker,local-whisper-chunked` | no | M3 |  |
| `MEETSUM_ASR_ALLOW_GEMINI` | app | dev | `false` | no | M3 | Gemini audio stays out of the ASR chain unless opted in (LLM transcript, synthetic word timings). Recipe "Lemonade + Gemini fallback" (the v0.6.0 `auto` behaviour, made explicit; docs/runbooks/free-tier-asr.md section 2d): set the chain to local-whisper-chunked, MEETSUM_ASR_ALLOW_GEMINI to true, LOCAL_TRANSCRIPTION_URL to the laptop's Lemonade server (Tailscale) and GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY (or Vertex). Gemini then receives the meeting audio whenever the laptop is unreachable; with GEMINI_TIER=free Google may use it to improve its products, so use a paid key or Vertex for confidential meetings. Boot warns when the Hebrew chain has only one configured provider. |
| `GOOGLE_GEMINI_AUDIO_PRICE_PER_MTOK` | app | optional |  | no | M3 |  |

| `MEETSUM_WORKER_HEALTH_HOST` | worker | optional | `0.0.0.0` | no | M10 |  |
| `MEETSUM_RATE_LIMIT_BACKEND` | app | optional |  | no | M10 | Rate-limit store: memory\|redis. Default: redis when REDIS_URL is set, else memory. On a Redis outage the cost/abuse presets (share verify, ask, LLM on-demand, auth, exports, search) fail closed; the rest fall back to memory. |
| `GOOGLE_OAUTH_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEYS_PREVIOUS` | app | optional |  | yes | M10 | Token-key rotation: comma-separated previous GOOGLE_OAUTH_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY values, tried for decryption only (encryption always uses the current key). Re-encrypt with: npx tsx scripts/reencrypt-tokens.ts (dry run unless --apply). |
| `PG_DUMP_CMD` | scripts | CI |  | no | M10 | Dev/CI only: pg_dump command for npm run db:schema:generate\|check, e.g. "docker exec <postgres container> pg_dump" so the client matches server 17. |
| `SCHEMA_CHECK_OUT` | scripts | optional |  | no | M10 | Dev/CI only: where db:schema:check writes the fresh dump on drift (CI uploads it as an artifact); default: a new temp directory. |
| `MEETSUM_IMAGE_TAG` | compose/infra | optional | `local` | no | M10 | docker compose: the image tag app, worker and migrate share (one build per deploy). |
